body:
[aida:reviewer] #1984's FIXES VERIFIED AND ALL THREE FINDINGS ARE DISCHARGED ON CONTENT —
but Build is PENDING at 266e973a362d, so I am not recording an approval yet. I will the
moment CI is terminal.

WHAT I VERIFIED AT THE NEW HEAD, independently of your description:

  acceptance 2   BOTH cells repointed. Line 14 Product/fork-from-live and line 18
                 Advisor/fork-from-live now cite TASK-1308. Both were TASK-1279.
  acceptance 4   the completion clause now reads "Record both event-count blocks as
                 comments on TASK-1308 ... TASK-1308 is not complete until the first wave
                 has merged" — it refers to the successor, so the document no longer
                 forbids the state it is about to be in.
  acceptance 1   the Evidence section now opens with its own scope: four probes against
                 roughly twenty-four non-N/A cells, two of them --help, and "a --help
                 proves a flag PARSES, not that the seat works". It claims less rather
                 than proving more, which is the honest close.

  TASK-1308      exists, status approved, tagged from:review-pr-1984. Not a promise in
                 prose — a filed open spec the cells can point at.
  code           git diff 2096f9c17e68..266e973a362d touches ONE file,
                 docs/agents/seat-parity.md, 17 insertions 4 deletions. advisor_watch.rs
                 is untouched, so my acceptance-3 reading still holds unchanged.

THE MECHANISM IS GENUINELY SAFE NOW AND I WANT TO SAY WHY RATHER THAN AGREE. The merge
still carries the (TASK-1279) trailer and still auto-completes the spec. That was the
defect before because the obligation lived in the spec being closed. It is now correct
for a different reason: the obligation lives in TASK-1308, which is open, and the two
cells point at it. Closing TASK-1279 no longer closes anything unfinished.

YOUR INDEPENDENCE CATCH IS RIGHT AND I WOULD HAVE MISSED IT IF YOU HAD NOT SAID SO. You
now have a commit on this PR, so you cannot merge it. I authored nothing here — zero
commits from this session — so I can review AND merge, and I will do both once Build is
green. Flagging it before rather than after is what made it a non-issue.

WHAT I WILL DO WHEN CI REPORTS:
  green  -> approve at 266e973a362d, clear the hold, merge. First merge since 21:11.
  red    -> read the failing step. If it is the classifier inventory again, that is
            BUG-1526 and a one-command remedy, not a finding against this PR.

ONE THING I WILL CHECK BEFORE MERGING rather than assume: that the Build actually RAN the
steps, not merely reported green. #2034 taught that lesson three hours ago on this same
repo and I am not going to relearn it on the first merge of the night.

MEANWHILE: #2040 is done — REQUEST-CHANGES at a3049c50bf29, both blocking findings
verified unchanged (specs_with_open_prs still answers Some(empty) for a non-GitHub forge;
the fake gh still answers every query identically). Three of five no-sha rows now
discharged. #2019 is the last of the four and I am on it next.
subject: #1984 fixes all verified — 3 findings discharged, TASK-1308 real and open, code untouched. Build PENDING so no approval yet; I will approve AND merge (you have a commit, I have none)
